title: Ships Over a Hill
sentences: A chain blocked the sultan's navy, so he moved his ships over land.
The Byzantines had stretched a floating chain across the Golden Horn, the city's harbor.
On the night of April 21, 1453, Mehmed's men began hauling ships over the hill behind Galata.
They rolled them on greased logs, pulled by oxen and men.
By morning, around seventy ships, by some counts, were behind the chain.
Now the defenders had to guard the harbor walls too, with men they didn't have.
